a16z-flow-life:lever:f5e24e68-5cf9-4e61-.description: About the Company At Flow, we’re reimagining what it means to live, work, and connect. More than just a real estate company, Flow is a brand, a technology platform, and an operations ecosystem spanning condominiums, hotels, multifamily residences, and office spaces. We’re building a new kind of living experience: one that’s flexible, connected, and designed to create genuine community and real value for the people who call Flow home. Our mission is oneness: prioritizing our residents and their experiences, and fostering connection with ourselves, their neighbors, and the natural world. By putting people at the center of everything we do, we’re creating vibrant, human-centered communities where life, work, creativity, and play all come together in one place. About the Role As the Head of Facilities, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction and operational excellence of our maintenance programs. Reporting directly to the Head of Operations/Property Management, you will oversee teams of dedicated professionals, developing best-in-class maintenance programs across our diverse portfolio of multifamily properties.
responsibilities: Provide technical and operational support to maintenance and operations teams, create  efficiencies, and meet maintenance performance standards
Develop, implement, and improve preventative maintenance programs
Inspect and audit properties to verify they are following company policies and procedures
Lead mitigation and remediation of larger maintenance-related issues
Identify life safety, employee safety, and physical hazards on-site and provide corrective solutions.
Ensure effective oversight and execution of work orders, unit turns, standard R&M, and preventative maintenance
Lead recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, training, and mentoring of facilities teams
Work directly with the Executive team to implement company and ownership goals for each property, centered around maximizing revenue and controlling expenses
Perform quarterly business reviews with regional service contractors to ensure they are performing to the requirements of their contracts and providing high-quality work
Monitor budgets and turnover expenditures to come up with cost reduction recommendations

Monitor and evaluate business performance by implementing and measuring key metrics surrounding but not limited to: preventative maintenance, compliance and inspections, standard operational reporting (e.g., work orders, unit turns), and resident feedback
Work closely with the Capital Projects Team, ensuring on-time and under-budget delivery of deferred maintenance projects, and providing support where necessary
Ensure properties are operating in accordance with all federal, state, and local requirements, including but not limited to OSHA, EPA, NFPA, electrical and building codes
Ensure compliance with company safety policies, and quickly identify and remediate safety hazards
Ensure facility team members complete required training and assist in developing and facilitating additional hands-on maintenance training classes
Perform regular portfolio-wide analyses of service contracts and system uptime
Review costs, scope, and performance of all recurring maintenance contracts, and recommend vendor and scope changes as necessary
Compare contract scopes and costs between properties and regions to surface opportunities for improvement and/or savings
Analyze and work to improve critical systems uptime (e.g., elevators, HVAC, electrical, fire & life safety)
Oversee all major critical systems repairs and upgrades
Required to visit all properties within the portfolio to ensure the efficient operation and coordination of all facilities departments.

Its products include Hivemind autonomy software and V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. Job Description: We are seeking a Manager of Propulsion to lead propulsion test development and execution for the X-BAT vehicle, powered by a fighter-class, afterburning jet engine. This role oversees propulsion test infrastructure, engine testing, subsystem validation, and flight test support activities required to mature propulsion hardware from development through operational readiness. You will lead a team of propulsion test engineers and technicians responsible for designing, building, and operating propulsion test stands and facilities supporting engine, fuel, oil, bleed air, and TVC systems. This role requires strong technical leadership, operational awareness, hands-on involvement in testing activities, and the ability to rapidly solve complex technical problems in demanding test environments.
responsibilities: Lead propulsion test planning and execution from component-level development through flight readiness.
Oversee the design, analysis, and construction of propulsion test stands, fixtures, instrumentation systems, and safety systems.

Ensure propulsion testing aligns with vehicle-level milestones and program priorities.
Lead development of test processes, standards, and operational best practices.

Hands-on experience designing or operating propulsion test stands and facilities.
Experience leading technical teams and coordinating complex test operations.
U.S. Citizenship or ability to comply with ITAR requirements.

Experience testing fighter-class or low-bypass turbofan propulsion systems.

Experience with controls integration, TVC testing, transient characterization, or operability mapping.
Background in rocket propulsion testing or hot-fire development environments.
Experience operating in hardware-centric, test-driven aerospace organizations.
M.S. or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering or related discipline.
